title: economics_result.json
description: One staged renovation plan priced by hisim.economics.staged, in the shape the RenoVisor frontend draws from (economics-hisim-spec.md section 3). Every amount is a band {min, best, max}; costs are positive and money arriving is negative; years are relative to the start of the horizon, and only the rows of the annual series carry a calendar year (annual[].calendar_year, null when the plan states no plan_start_year); every subject, asset class, measure and scheme is an id the frontend labels itself.

schema_version.description: 7 since 2026-09-27 (renovisorissues #59, hisim-ryw1): every by_subject row carries the required replaces_subjects, the reference subjects the row's subject replaces (empty for a row no measure created), and the do-nothing reference renews the building fabric: every existing envelope element no measure replaces is a subject envelope_<element> of its own (roof, facade, floor, window, door), kept and renewed like-for-like at the end of its service life (the cost database's life for the class, else the engine's fallback, service_life_origin engine_fallback), dated from its installation_year (mid-life when the request states none), on the reference and on every stage that keeps it; its renewals are unpriced (HiSim prices no envelope work, and no cost band reaches a kept element), so the row states the years and no money. Also in 7: the plan books no anyway-cost credit for what it replaces (full-cost method: the reference pays every end-of-life renewal), so plan totals and comparison deltas of version 6 are not comparable. Also in 7 (renovisorissues #65): every subsidies[] row carries the required max_amount_for_measure_in_euro, the scheme's maximum over all of the row's measure's subjects in its stage; a soft loan with no repayment grant states max_amount_in_euro null, not a zero band; a by_subject row of a subject no stage paid for (kept equipment, a kept envelope element) states stage null on the plan too. 6 since 2026-09-26 (renovisorissues #53, #54): parameters carries the required investment_overrides, the reader's quotes the plan was priced with (each replaces the year-0 investment of the measure's main subject in its stage; the measure's other subjects there are bought at zero), every by_subject row carries the required investment_origin and investment_source, and every subsidies[] row carries the required max_amount_in_euro, the most the scheme can pay for the row's subject whatever the row's status. 5 since 2026-09-26 (renovisorissues #57), a breaking change: parameters.simulation_year is renamed parameters.weather_year (the year of the weather the stages were simulated with; it dates nothing), parameters carries the required plan_start_year (the calendar year of the plan's year 0, or null), and every annual[].calendar_year is plan_start_year + year, null when plan_start_year is null, no longer simulation_year + year. Also in 5: every by_subject row carries the required service_life_origin, installation_year, installation_year_origin and note, service_life_years states the lifetime the engine used whether the cost database or the request gave it, and every measure a stage carries out has a by_subject row, a zero one of its own for a measure the engine prices no subject for (renovisorissues #58). 4 since 2026-09-26: parameters.escalation.energy states the per-carrier rate actually used for every carrier a stage bills and every carrier the plan named, no longer only the stated ones, and parameters carries the required energy_prices (the year-1 prices used, the working price all-in with carbon) and origins (where each came from) (renovisorissues #52). 3 since 2026-09-26: every by_subject row carries the required investment_by_stage, the subject's investment split by the stage that bought it (renovisorissues #48, hisim-fig7). 2 since 2026-09-24: a subsidies[] row the plan awarded states amount_by_year_in_euro and an amount (hisim-cyc.5), and totals and comparison carry the headline monthly_equivalent_cost_in_euro / monthly_equivalent_cost_delta_in_euro (hisim-cyc.6).

hisim_commit.description: Short commit of the HiSim checkout, from hisim/COMMIT, HISIM_COMMIT or git; null outside a repository.

plan_start_year.description: The calendar year of the plan's year 0, as the plan stated it; null when it stated none. Also an input of `staged --parameters`, and the anchor of the price basis year when neither the stages nor the parameters state one, clamped to the earliest year the country's device data covers (origins.price_basis_year then says plan_start_year).

weather_year.description: The year of the weather the stages were simulated with (simulation_year up to schema version 4). A fact of the run, accepted and ignored on input; it dates nothing in this document.

subsidy_mode.description: Whether the subsidy catalogue was applied at all; also an input of `staged --parameters`.

financing.description: How the investment was paid for; also an input of `staged --parameters`.

energy.description: The per-carrier energy price escalation rate each carrier was priced with, for every carrier a stage bills and every carrier the plan named; origins.escalation.energy says where each came from. As an input of `staged --parameters` a rate here is stated; ELECTRICITY_FEED_IN is refused, its remuneration follows feed_in.

energy_prices.description: The year-1 price terms each carrier was priced with, for every carrier a stage bills at a flat price and every carrier the plan named; the working price is all-in (carbon included), for ELECTRICITY_FEED_IN it is the feed-in rate. As an input of `staged --parameters` each value may also be a bare number.

investment_overrides.description: The reader's quoted prices the plan was priced with, one per measure of a stage, in the order they were given; empty without any. Each replaces the year-0 investment (investment, planning and removal) of the measure's main subject in that stage; the measure's other subjects in that stage are bought at zero, keep their lifetimes and their later, database-priced replacements. The quote is exact and is booked as stated, nominal in its stage's year, never escalated, whatever year the stage starts in. Also an input of `staged --parameters`, where a stage the plan does not have, a measure the stage does not carry out, a measure that costs nothing (change_room_temperature) and a second quote for one measure of one stage are refused.

subsidy_catalog.description: The catalogue in force (country and snapshot date), or null when none was loaded. Documentation of what produced this document: it is accepted and ignored as an input of `staged --parameters`, where the catalogue comes from the shipped directory or `--subsidy-catalog`.

origins.description: Where each echoed per-carrier rate and price came from; the price basis year, only when plan_start_year supplied it; and the years every amount was escalated between, only when plan_start_year differs from the price basis year. Documentation of the run: accepted and ignored as an input of `staged --parameters`.

price_basis_year.description: Present only when neither the stages nor the parameters stated a price basis year and parameters.plan_start_year supplied it (clamped to the earliest year the country's device data covers); absent otherwise.

from_year.description: The year the prices were read at: parameters.price_basis_year.

to_year.description: The year whose money every amount is in: parameters.plan_start_year.

price_level.description: Present only when parameters.plan_start_year is stated and differs from parameters.price_basis_year: every amount of the document was escalated from from_year to to_year (de-escalated when to_year is earlier) with the rate it escalates with in later years — the investment rate of its asset class for a purchase, its replacements, residual value and share-of-cost subsidies, the general rate for maintenance and standing charges, the carrier, spread, grid-fee and feed-in rates for the energy bill, the CO2 path read to_year − from_year years later — except a reader's quote and a fixed-amount grant, booked as stated. The echoed energy_prices remain the year-1 terms read at from_year. Absent when nothing was escalated.

groups.description: The eight cost stacks, in the fixed order every chart draws them in.

monthly_equivalent_cost_delta_in_euro.description: equivalent_annual_cost_delta_in_euro divided by twelve: the headline monthly difference, plan minus reference.

discounted_payback_year.description: The first year the plan has paid back, per uncertainty slot; null means never within the horizon.

band.description: One amount in the engine's three uncertainty slots.

groupStack.description: One band per group; all eight are present even at zero, so a stack never shifts.

evaluation.description: One variant priced over the horizon: the reference or the staged plan, in the same shape.

monthly_equivalent_cost_in_euro.description: equivalent_annual_cost_in_euro divided by twelve: the level monthly cost over the whole horizon, and the headline monthly figure.

monthly_cost_year1_in_euro.description: Year 1's cash divided by twelve, replacements included: the first year's cost, not a running cost.

stage.description: On the plan, the stage the row is attributed to: the last stage that paid for the subject, or, for a row of a measure the engine prices no subject for, the first stage carrying the measure out; null for a subject no stage paid for and on every reference row.

investment_in_euro.description: Year-0 investment: the investment, planning and removal booked in year 0, by every stage that starts then. Stages starting later are in investment_by_stage.

investment_origin.description: Where the purchase the row describes was priced from (on the plan the purchase of the row's stage, on the reference stage 0's): the reader's quote from parameters.investment_overrides, as the measure's main subject (reader_quote); within that quote, as a further subject of the quoted measure, bought at zero (included_in_reader_quote); the request's own price (request); the cost database (cost_database). Null on a carrier row, an unpriced row and a measure-only row.

investment_source.description: The source of a reader_quote or included_in_reader_quote row as the quote states it, or the request's source sentence of a request row; null otherwise.

investment_by_stage.description: The subject's investment split by the stage that bought it: one entry per stage whose evaluation booked investment, planning or removal for the subject on the plan's timeline, ascending by stage, each the nominal amount in the year that stage starts. Kept or carried-over subjects have no entry; reference rows carry an empty list.

service_life_years.description: The service life the engine priced the subject with, in years. Null exactly when service_life_origin is: a carrier row, a synthetic subject's row (financing, replacement reserve, CO2 damage), or a row of a measure the engine prices no subject for (a setting, a measure HiSim holds no price for), which states no life because nothing prices one.

service_life_origin.description: Where service_life_years came from: a lifetime the calculation's inputs state (request), the cost database's entry for the asset class at the price basis year (cost_database), or the engine's fallback life where the database has no entry for the class (engine_fallback, since schema 7).

installation_year.description: The calendar year the subject counts as installed in: for equipment the house already had and keeps, the existing-asset register's year, from which the engine schedules its replacements; for a subject a stage bought, the plan's year 0 + that stage's from_year, where year 0 is plan_start_year, else price_basis_year (the year the house's own equipment is aged at too). Null exactly when service_life_years is.

installation_year_origin.description: Where installation_year came from: the request states it (request); an undated device or envelope element assumed at mid-life, price_basis_year - round(service_life / 2), never before the construction year (mid_life_default); an undated envelope element taking the construction year, in a register stored before 2026-09-27 (construction_year_default); the start of the stage that bought it (stage). Null when installation_year is, or when the register did not say.

replaces_subjects.description: The reference subjects the row's subject replaces, from the translator's existing-asset register (the entries whose replaced_by_asset_classes name the subject's asset class): external_insulation replaces envelope_facade, a new heat pump the reference's boiler. Empty on a row no measure created, and so on every reference row of a subject stages[0] does not carry out.

note.description: Why the row has no price (unpriced) or costs nothing (a setting, not a purchase), or what a reader's quote made of it (priced by it, bought within it); null otherwise.

allOf.description: service_life_years is null exactly when service_life_origin is.
installation_year is null exactly when service_life_years is.
installation_year_origin is null when installation_year is (and may be null beside a year the register did not say the origin of).

calendar_year.description: parameters.plan_start_year + year; null when the plan states no start year.

amount_in_euro.description: The support this scheme pays on this timeline, negative like every credit. Always a band for an awarded scheme: a benefit that pays no cash (loan terms, a VAT reduction) states a zero band and says in `note` where its money is, except that a soft loan's repayment grant is stated on the first loan-terms row of its scheme. Null only for a scheme that was refused or could not be decided: an unanswered question is never published as a zero.

amount_by_year_in_euro.description: The years `amount_in_euro` is booked in, relative 0..T like `annual[].year`, one entry per year with a booking, ascending; the entries sum to `amount_in_euro` slot by slot. In every year the awarded rows' entries sum to that year's `annual[].by_group.Subsidies`. Null exactly when `amount_in_euro` is.

max_amount_in_euro.description: The most the scheme can pay for the row's subject under the house and plan as stated, whatever the row's status, negative like amount_in_euro and moved into the plan the way the stage's award is: LUMP_SUM its amount, PER_UNIT and TIERED_PER_UNIT the amount for the stated size (each clamped to the eligible cost where the scheme counts cost categories), SHARE_OF_ELIGIBLE_COST and BONUS_SHARE the scheme's full rate times the eligible cost capped by the scheme's eligible-basis cap (a rate a cumulation group would scale down, depending on which answers stack, is stated at its larger, unscaled value), TAX_CREDIT the whole credit, SOFT_LOAN its repayment grant (null for a loan with none), OPERATIONAL the rate times the annual energy times the duration; the catalogue's overall state-aid share bounds it as it bounds an award. Nominal amounts (LUMP_SUM, PER_UNIT, TIERED_PER_UNIT, an eligible-basis cap) are clamped to the eligible cost in the money of plan year 0 (plan_start_year), not of the price basis year; a stage starting later books that figure unescalated. Null where the scheme states no amount it pays: a VAT reduction, a soft loan without a repayment grant (a loan, no grant element: its benefit is in the financing costs), a plan with no catalogue; `note` then says so.

max_amount_for_measure_in_euro.description: The most the scheme can pay for the row's whole measure in the row's stage: the slot-wise sum of max_amount_in_euro over the rows of the same scheme, measure_id and stage (one row per subject of the measure the scheme covers), stated on each of them. Null where max_amount_in_euro is null and on a row with no measure_id.
